resources.title: District-wise, season-wise crop production statistics
resources.unit: area in hectares, production in tonnes
resources.notes: Allahabad (= Prayagraj) has 470 rows across 38 crops. District mean yields 2007-14: wheat ~2.3, paddy ~2.4, potato ~16.3 t/ha. 2014 is an outlier low year and should not be read alone.
